Compared a.mp4 and b.mp4. I found 7 change(s):
1. Removed - chair: The chair was removed from the scene.
2. Removed - chair leg: The chair leg was removed from the scene.
3. Removed - chair leg: The chair leg was removed.
4. Removed - chair leg: The chair leg and black object were removed from the scene.
5. Removed - chair backrest: Possibly the chair backrest was removed.
6. Removed - stacked bowls: Possibly the stacked bowls were removed.
7. Added - small brown object: A small brown object appeared on the surface in the second image.

Notes: Object names come from a vision-language model and can be wrong. Detection thresholds were tuned on the development scenes (demo, scene2, scene3, scene4). No absolute distances are reported (the reconstruction scale is not metric-validated); directions refer to the before/after videos as stated.
